# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b95 — room air refresh and open-window energy guidance

Beta95 builds directly on verified Beta94 and adds two **advisory-only** per-room monitors. No new device-control authority, physical command, guessed pollutant measurement or sensor entity is introduced.

## Time-based fresh-air reminders where no indoor pollutant sensor exists

- A room with **no actual CO₂, PM, VOC, NO₂, O₃, SO₂ or AQI sensor** receives an air-refresh opportunity after a **verified wake-up** (sleeping → awake while occupied) or a return after **at least two hours of confirmed vacancy**. Relative humidity, temperature, illuminance and inferred mold risk never masquerade as direct air-quality measurements.
- The first Home Assistant observation is just a baseline. Missing, ambiguous or stale room presence cannot fabricate a return; a selected but temporarily offline indoor AQ sensor remains treated as an installed sensor.
- An opening suggestion is queued only while **the room is occupied and awake**, no window is known open or uncertain, and HEM's independently evaluated outdoor-air/weather safety says ventilation is permissible. An unsafe outdoor interval defers—not reverses—the event for up to 35 minutes.
- An existing open window cancels the redundant air-refresh prompt. Successful Hub/direct delivery consumes the event, while a four-hour per-room cooldown suppresses repetitive wake/return nudges.
- Message wording explicitly says this is based on occupancy timing, **not a measurement of stale or polluted air**.

## Close windows when measured temperature approaches active HVAC setpoints

- Watches actual **open window contacts for the same room** and an independently validated physical room-temperature measurement.
- Compares temperature with **currently selected, supported heating/cooling setpoints** of configured HVAC controllers, respecting their HEM room profiles. DRY-only dehumidifiers, fans and devices without thermal capability are excluded.
- After at least **three minutes of verified open-window observation**, warns when a falling indoor temperature is within 0.8°C above the heating target, or a rising temperature within 0.8°C below the cooling target, after an actual ≥0.2°C trend.
- Close-window warnings do not require favorable outside conditions. If the window closes, the temperature reading disappears, or the configured HVAC setpoint is unavailable, no unsupported temperature-based command is issued; the warning is advisory only.
- An existing outdoor-hazard close recommendation remains higher priority than the energy warning, and a measured thermal close recommendation overrides an unrelated open-window suggestion for the same room.

## Dashboard and announcements

- Compact, localized (Greek, German, English) room information indicates whether time-based refresh monitoring is in use and when airing or closing windows is recommended; languages without dedicated new text use English rather than untranslated code.
- Existing Announcement Hub, notification, TTS, per-room routing and AI-rewrite paths are reused. No extra entities, air-quality estimates or timers controlling hardware are created.
- The new room data appears in `environment.room_ventilation` as monitor status and source-qualified heat/cool targets. Existing physical-device errors, automatic/PID control, safety pauses, outdoor exclusions, window scoping and compressor minimum ON/OFF limits remain unchanged.

## Verification

Runs real source-defined presence/absence transition simulations, air-quality source classification, active HVAC target compatibility, actual open-window temperature slopes, window resets, absence of sensor readings, localization and Chromium mobile card tests. Also reruns Beta66–94 window, room isolation, physical acknowledgement/retry, DRY-only, power switch, PID restart, and card/browser regressions.

**Operational limits:** The monitor cannot infer the true air quality without an indoor sensor. A sleeping-room transition or long vacancy must be verifiable, and temperature loss must be measured. It does not promise immediate comfort changes or actuate windows/climate equipment.

## Install

Update through HACS prereleases to **v0.6.0b95**, restart Home Assistant, and hard-refresh Lovelace to load the new frontend JavaScript.
